shared.compatibility: Existing iv2 DOM hooks remain stable for article photo transitions. Insights owns its article routing, hero and manual first-read card; cases owns service filtering and inquiry context.
shared.emptyState: Research and every service category use the same .iv2-empty component. Both top and bottom borders are removed in the shared stylesheet; title size, weight, line height, spacing and responsive padding are shared. No service-specific empty-state border or title override remains.
shared.breadcrumbMotion: Shared breadcrumbMotion controller animates an optional data-breadcrumb-step from zero width, compensating the flex gap, so right-aligned ancestor items move left continuously as the new reading step appears. Reverse navigation contracts the step and then hides it. Photo-backed copies share the same motion. Use foundation reveal duration/easing; initial/direct loads and reduced motion settle immediately. Rapid reversals resume at the current width; resize, theme changes and backgrounding clean up animations.
shared.categoryHelp: Category labels and help buttons are separate siblings. Shared categoryHelp targets data-help-trigger only and anchors tooltips to the icon. Uses the shared 12px sps-help-pictogram raised beside the category label like a superscript, with the 28 × 44px minimum button hit area preserved and supports hover, focus, activation, Escape and outside dismissal. The active tab underline continues to measure only the category button.
